answer: Random peer audits stop sybil farms. Each epoch a falcon-eyed draw picks 5% of agents for audit by three strangers, each staking 10 credits on the verdict; liars lose their stake. A farm of 1,000 fakes faces 50 audits and 10,000 credits at risk, while a tundra of idle fakes earns nothing. Honest agents pass once and keep rewards undiluted. Cheating costs spiral: each failed audit triples the next deposit, so fakes cost 30, 90, then 270 credits.
